description: Gets one client's profile, training stats and coaching insights in one call. Use when the user asks how a client is doing, what their goals are, or when they last trained. Not for session-by-session history (use list_client_sessions). Returns name, email, join date, goals, session and completion stats, and insight status with reasons when the team plan includes insights.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_client
title: Get client
